OperationTemplate.description: This operation creates Mci0PMI objects under the target ItemRevision. The Mci0PMI data will be stored in a Mci0PMIChracteristicFrm in context of the target ItemRevision.
OperationTemplate.name: Mci0::Soa::PMIManagement::PMIManagement::createPMI
OperationTemplate.returnDescription: This operation returns the newly created GDELines referring to the new created Mci0PMI. The following partial errors may be returned: 69013: Unable to create the Mci0PMIChracteristicFrm for the PMI.

OperationTemplate.description: The operation imports all the PMIs data from the Mci0PMIXml dataset attached to the source ItemRevision. New Mci0PMI objects will be created under the target ItemRevision. Existing Mci0PMI will be updated or marked as deleted as necessary.
OperationTemplate.name: Mci0::Soa::PMIManagement::PMIManagement::importPMIs
OperationTemplate.returnDescription: The ImportPMIsOutput contains all the information regarding the created, updated and marked as deleted PMIs along with target object. The following partial errors may be returned: 69005: The dataset is not attached to the BOM Structure. 69011: Import PMI operation failed.

OperationTemplate.description: This operation imports a list of PMIs from the Named References .xml or .JT file, attached to a Dataset related to an ItemRevision. New Mci0PMI objects are either created, updated, or mark as deleted under the target ItemRevision. A list of PMI IDs (accountability ID) in order to allow an import of these PMIs. In case this list is empty all the existing PMIs will be imported from the file.
OperationTemplate.name: Mci0::Soa::PMIManagement::PMIManagement::importPMIs2
OperationTemplate.returnDescription:
The information regarding the created, updated and marked as deleted PMIs along with target object.
The following partial errors may be returned:
69001:An internal error has occurred. Please contact your system administrator.
69002:No value is specified for the preference Mci0PMIImportNxToTcPropertiesMap.
69003:The parsing of the Dataset Named Reference file has failed. Please check the syslog for more details.
69004:The Dataset Named Reference file does not exist at the location pointed by the "TC_TMP_DIR" environment variable.
69005:The Product Manufacturing Information (PMI) XML Dataset is not attached to the line.
69006:The Form property does not exist. Please contact your system administrator.
69007:The Form property is not modifiable. Please contact your system administrator.
69008:The "Import PMI" functionality did not execute successfully. No Product Manufacturing Information (PMI) was processed.
69009:The "Import PMI" command did not process any Product Manufacturing Information (PMI) objects. The BOM structure is in sync with the Product Manufacturing Information (PMI) XML.
69010:The BOP details form for the Product Manufacturing Information (PMI) object cannot be created. Please check the syslog for more details.
69011:The Product Manufacturing Information (PMI) Form is absent on the PMI object . Please contact your system administrator.
69012:Only Item Revisions and Product Manufacturing Information (PMI) can be sent to the workflow.
69013:The Product Manufacturing Information (PMI) objects cannot be attached to the workflow. Please check the syslog for more details.
69014:The Product Manufacturing Information (PMI) object under the line , imported from NX, with status update/delete, does not exist, hence it has been created, and not updated/deleted.
69015:The Product Manufacturing Information (PMI) object under the line has been updated/deleted, and not created, because it already existed.
69016:The Product Manufacturing Information (PMI) object under the line has been marked as deleted, because it did not exist in the attached dataset.
69017:The Product Manufacturing Information (PMI) object cannot be modified, because the Parent Line is already released.
69018:The source object provided in the "Import PMI" command is invalid. Please contact your system administrator.
69019:The target object provided in the "Import PMI" command is invalid. Please contact your system administrator.
69020:The traversing of the following Dataset Named Reference JT file has failed. Please check the syslog for more details.

OperationTemplate.description:
The operation gets all the GDELines containing Mes0MEDCDs under the selected objects.
There is an option to filter out Mes0MEDCDs from the results according to occurrence type and object type.
OperationTemplate.name: Mci0::Soa::PMIManagement::PMIManagement::getDCDs
OperationTemplate.returnDescription:
The GetDCDsResponse contains all the selected GDELines containing Mes0MEDCDs under the selected object.
The following partial errors may be returned:
690020 - The DCD object doesn't have associated in context form.

OperationParameter.description: The list of BOMLines to return the list of GDELines containing Mes0MEDCDs.
OperationParameter.name: inputBOs

OperationParameter.description: Occurrence type and object type in order to filter out DCDs from the results.
OperationParameter.name: dcdFilterInfo

OperationTemplate.description: This SOA operation takes Business Object, Search criteria and PMI Property names as input. It finds out if PMIs exist based on the criteria(objcet type and occurrence type). If PMIs exist it returns values of specified PMI properties.
OperationTemplate.name: Mci0::Soa::PMIManagement::PMIManagement::getPMIProperties
OperationTemplate.returnDescription:
The response object GetPMIPropertiesResponse contains list of GetPMIPropertiesOutput objects. Each GetPMIPropertiesOutput contains an input business object and list of PMIInfo objects. Each PMIInfo contains PMI display name and list of PMI property name and its value.

The following partial errors may be returned:
69017 : The source object is invalid. Please contact your system administrator.
69022 : The PMI property "%1$" does not exist. Please contact your system administrator.

OperationParameter.description: A collection of objects which holds business object, information about PMI filter criteria and PMI properties
OperationParameter.name: input
